description:
A timeless and empowering tennis necklace featuring 10.00 ct total carat weight diamonds, designed to symbolize confidence, strength, and elegance.

Available in 14K white gold or yellow gold, with natural or lab-grown diamond options. The lab-grown diamond version starts at $11,000; natural diamond pricing is quoted on request.
care: Store flat, avoid fragrance contact, and clean gently to protect the diamond setting.
shipping: Made to order with timing confirmed after diamond and metal selection.
